name: kudos-collector-offline
description: Collects concrete, evidenced recognition examples per person from a PR list, Slack praise and shipped features you paste (sections PRs: / Praise: / Shipped:, CSV or JSON PR exports, optional Aliases: like '@pdev = Priya Dev', Period: Q3, People:, Min:). Each example says what the person did, when, and the evidence (PR number/link or the quote); impact only if the record states it. PR authors and feature owners are read in code; names in praise must be written in the message; first-name-only names are never merged; vague praise ('great job!') is counted, not used. People are listed alphabetically with counts of evidence items: it never ranks, scores or compares people and does not write the review (Performance Review Drafter can use its output). Follow-ups: only Priya Dev, only PRs, show the quotes, unattributed records, add these, as json. Works only on pasted data: it reads no code host or chat.

skills.name: Recognition examples per person
skills.description: Turns pasted PRs, praise messages and shipped features into per-person, evidenced examples for reviews or promotion cases, alphabetical and never ranked.
examples: Collect kudos for my team from these PRs and Slack praise: <paste>
Which praise was too general to use?
